units.source_text: 一旦下了这样的决心，我就不谈对种种情况产生的动摇，也不谈来来回回的经过。

en.t: Once I had made this decision, I will not speak of the wavering that arose from various circumstances, nor of the back-and-forth course of events.
My thoughts were no longer changeable.

units.source_text: 这半年我的目光凝视着一个未来而坚定不移。

en.t: For these six months, my gaze had fixed steadily on a single future.

units.source_text: 这期间的我，大概值得了幸福的意义。

en.t: During this time, I was probably worthy of the meaning of happiness.
